title: ÄCTION!
intro: Everyone looks the same. Everyone says the same thing. Time to change that.
mission: From Valais to other planets. Collect Loki Coins and bring character to every world.
double: Tap again for a double jump
boostHint: Ten green rectangles. Eight seconds of full power.
howJump: Tap or press Space to jump. Press again in the air for a double jump.
howIdeas: Collect the golden Loki coins with the Shih Tzu face. Every coin scores points.
howDots: Ten green rectangles charge your superpower: “superpowär!”, a neon-green cape, drum and bass, invulnerability and double pickup points. Enemies and obstacles burst into neon green.
howHazards: Jump over obstacles and opponents. Level 2 adds the tax inspector and Schnydär bus; level 3 the raclette man with his oven and knife; level 4 the Hérens cow and Oli in his excavator. Double-jump over the raclette oven and vehicles! At level 5 a UFO with an alien arrives: stay underneath or shoot it with the laser. From level 7 it also flies low. Daria appears every third level: 3, 6, 9…
howEnd: The pace builds gradually. There is a little more time to react between obstacles, with short collecting breaks. After a hit, you are protected for 1.2 seconds. Start with three hearts. Every 20 seconds, the next level begins: speed and difficulty increase, and you regain one heart, up to three. Your run ends at zero hearts. Your record stays on this device. Every 30 seconds the scene smoothly blends into a new world: an alien planet, jungle, hell, heaven, ancient Greece and Egypt. Then the journey continues.
tip2: Flying clichés? Stay on the ground.
endText: Survived {time}. Reached level {level}. One more try?
shareText: I survived {time}, reached level {level} and scored {score} points in ÄCTION! Can you beat that?
noFullscreen: Open the game directly for full screen.
footer: Clarity that sticks. Creativity that hits.
accessNote: You can adjust sound and motion before you start.
tapHint: JUMP ON THE RIGHT · LASER ON THE LEFT
helpHint: Ten green rectangles = eight seconds of superpower
integrationIntro: Paste this code into an HTML element on your website. The game height adapts to the screen size.
continueHint: The run was paused when you left the window.
canvasLabel: Endless run. Jump over ground obstacles and stay beneath high planes and drones. New level and one heart every 20 seconds, up to three. Daria every third level. New world: VALAIS, PLANET X, JUNGLE, HELL, HEAVEN, ANCIENT GREECE, EGYPT Fire the laser with X or K. Jump over people, sheep and vehicles.
soundBlocked: Sound could not start. Tap “Enable sound”.
powerActive: Superpower active: invincible with double collectible points
howLaser: Tap Laser or press X / K. One shot every 5 seconds: clichés, cones, barriers, rolls, paper planes, drones and UFOs give 15 points per hit. The beam flies straight at your firing height. Jump to aim higher. Jump over people, animals and vehicles.
